patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts for profile sections, alternating image and text placement on left/right sides as the user scrolls down.
High-contrast dark mode with a vibrant, energetic lime green (#f2ff4c) used as a primary accent color for CTAs, logos, and key text highlights against a deep charcoal background.
Large, bold, modern sans-serif headings create strong visual impact, complemented by smaller, uppercase labels for section introductions and sub-headings.

The hero section features a full-bleed video background that remains fixed or subtly parallaxes while overlaid text and a call-to-action scroll up and out of view. Subsequent content sections reveal with a staggered fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport.
A dedicated 'updates' section provides key announcements and bulleted information, breaking from the visual flow with a distinct, more text-heavy presentation.

technique_notes: The site utilizes a smooth scrolling library (locomotive-scroll) to create a fluid user experience and enable precise scroll-triggered animations.

A full-bleed video is used as a hero background, with text and a call-to-action overlaid. The video either remains fixed or has a subtle parallax effect as the user scrolls, allowing content to scroll over it.
Content sections and individual elements within them are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, typically fading in and sliding up from the bottom as they enter the viewport.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, often uppercase, supporting labels and standard body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on interactive elements like buttons and the cookie banner, otherwise sharp edges dominate the layout.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy spacing in the hero section and between major content blocks, transitioning to a more balanced density within text-heavy sections and profile cards.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, moody dark theme paired with a highly energetic, almost neon, lime accent color creates a powerful visual identity. This is amplified by the emotional, community-focused video hero and the smooth, scroll-triggered content reveals, making the experience feel premium and engaging.
